name: liberia-online-library
description: Liberia Online Library — a full-featured digital library: catalog, lending, holds, an in-browser reader, reading stats and a librarian desk.

scripts.build: node scripts/copy-voice-runtime.js && tsc -p client/tsconfig.json --noEmit && vite build
scripts.build:pages: node scripts/copy-voice-runtime.js && VITE_STATIC=1 vite build --base=${PAGES_BASE:-/LIB-library/} --outDir ../dist-pages && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning scripts/build-pages-data.js dist-pages && cp dist-pages/index.html dist-pages/404.html && touch dist-pages/.nojekyll
